submitted_sql: WITH customer_purchase AS (SELECT c.customer_id, SUM(i.total) AS purchase_amount FROM public.invoice i JOIN public.customer c ON c.customer_id = i.customer_id WHERE i.invoice_date >= DATE '2022-01-01' AND i.invoice_date < DATE '2023-01-01' GROUP BY c.customer_id) SELECT cp.customer_id, cp.purchase_amount FROM customer_purchase cp ORDER BY cp.purchase_amount DESC, cp.customer_id ASC LIMIT 1;
validated_sql: WITH customer_purchase AS (SELECT c.customer_id, SUM(i.total) AS purchase_amount FROM public.invoice AS i JOIN public.customer AS c ON c.customer_id = i.customer_id WHERE i.invoice_date >= CAST('2022-01-01' AS DATE) AND i.invoice_date < CAST('2023-01-01' AS DATE) GROUP BY c.customer_id) SELECT cp.customer_id, cp.purchase_amount FROM customer_purchase AS cp ORDER BY cp.purchase_amount DESC, cp.customer_id ASC LIMIT 1
